[1] Global interpreter lock - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Global_interpreter_lock
    A global interpreter lock (GIL) is a mutual-exclusion lock held by a programming language interpreter thread to avoid sharing code that is not thread-safe with other threads. In implementations with a GIL, there is always one GIL for each interpreter process.

answer:
PEP 703 proposed making the CPython global interpreter lock (GIL) optional [S1].  

- **What is the PEP titled/described as?** “**PEP 703 - Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython**” [S1].  
- **What does it explicitly propose regarding the GIL being optional?** It proposes adding a **build configuration option `--disable-gil`** to CPython so the GIL can be turned off for a free-threaded build [S1].
